housing: Louisville's older rentals are shotgun houses, camelbacks and Victorian homes split into apartments; the suburbs add apartment complexes and single-family houses.

climate: Humid summers and cold snaps mean you should test both heating and air conditioning, check basements for damp, and photograph any water stains near the Ohio River flood plain.
fact: Louisville Metro passed a right-to-counsel ordinance in 2021 to give low-income renters free lawyers in eviction cases.
